identity.mission: Create a high-performance, semi-dark crypto farming dashboard that feels like a command center, not a spreadsheet.
principles: Fusion: Mix Fintech precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics.
Density: Data is money. High information density without clutter.
Contrast: Neon accents on deep black backgrounds for readability and vibe.

cards.base: bg-[#0F0F0F] border border-[#27272A] shadow-sm rounded-xl overflow-hidden

inputs.base: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-[#27272A] focus:border-[#00E054] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E054] text-white placeholder:text-gray-600

tables.header: bg-[#1A1A1A] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 font-mono

layouts.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 auto-rows-[minmax(180px,auto)]

assets.image_style: High contrast, dark cinematic, neon accents
search_queries: crypto mining farm server rack dark neon

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text-gray-400 or darker is not used on black backgrounds without checking APCA.
accessibility.focus_states: Focus rings must be visible and use the primary neon color.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement 'recharts' for the profit dashboard using the custom neon palette.
Create a 'WhatsAppBulkSender' component that handles the loop and opens tabs with delays.
Ensure the 'Payments' grid handles horizontal scrolling on mobile.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors with subtle noise or grid patterns.
Every interactive element must have a hover state.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs.
